pages.text: $(danger)Pre-meltdown$() lasts $(num)90$() seconds.$(br2)Fix whatever caused it. If stability gets back above 35%, stress is under 90% and the structure is whole, the reactor recovers.
pages.title: Pre-meltdown

pages.text: $(num)120$() seconds. The core pulls in mobs, players and items within $(num)20$() blocks and hurts anything close.$(br2)There is no way back from here yet. $(danger)Get out.$()
pages.title: Phase 1

pages.text: $(num)60$() seconds. The pull reaches $(num)32$() blocks and hits much harder. Then the core $(danger)collapses$().$(br2)Blast radius: 12 blocks plus 1 per 5,000 mass, up to 40.
pages.title: Phase 2

pages.text: Server owners can turn off block damage and change every number in this book in the server config.
pages.title: Config
